chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) liked the sweet basil among the vegetables.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.الْحَوْك: Sweet basil (a specific type of herb)

ai.seo_question: What vegetable did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) particularly like?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) regarding the consumption of sweet basil (al-hawk), reflecting the Islamic emphasis on simple, natural sustenance. It serves as a practical example of the Prophet's dietary preferences, often cited in Shia jurisprudence and medicine to validate the health benefits of common vegetables.
